ModMetadata.Name: StationGod MCP
ModMetadata.Author: XCeled
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Let an AI agent read and run your Stationeers base[/h1] StationGod MCP connects an AI agent such as Claude Code or Codex to your running game through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the standard way these agents call outside tools. The agent can then read every device, chip, room, network and planet value you could look up yourself, and act on them: write logic, program chips, move gas and items, and build or rebuild cables, pipes, chutes, walls and frames with the checks the game itself applies.
[hr][/hr] [h2]What the agent can do[/h2] [list] [*][b]Devices and logic:[/b] find devices anywhere in the world, read and write their logic values, slots and memory, many at once, and record how values change over time. [*][b]Chips:[/b] read, write, compile, pause, step and restart IC10 programs, including a suit's chip, and set IC Housing pins. With StationeersLua installed, also Lua chips on consoles, computers, tablets and visors, with their errors and print log. [*][b]Your base and planet:[/b] rooms and their air, the planet's atmosphere and weather, plants and their genes, damage, fire risk, water, food, your vitals, the game clock, what you are looking at. [*][b]Items and gas:[/b] find and count items, move them between slots, label and paint structures, move gas between canisters, tanks, pipe networks, landing pads and rooms. [*][b]Solar, dishes and traders:[/b] aim solar panels and satellite dishes, check landing pads, buy and sell with a landed trader. [*][b]Cables, pipes and chutes:[/b] plan a route, lay it, remove it or reroute it. Every piece gets the right shape for its connections, runs follow frames rather than crossing open air, and a run that would join two networks, overload a cable, burst a pipe or push items the wrong way is refused or flagged. [*][b]Upgrades and clean-up:[/b] turn a cable network into heavy or super heavy cable, or a pipe network into insulated pipe, in place; replace junctions that have open ends, merge or split long straights, cut redundant loops and remove dead-end stubs; clear chute pieces no item can pass through to a machine. [*][b]Walls, frames and structures:[/b] swap walls, windows and frames for another kind without opening the room to the air, place any structure a kit builds, and remove structures as deconstruction does. [*][b]Ingot Vault:[/b] with the Ingot Vault mod installed, read a vault's store exactly and move ingots, ores and ices straight in and out of it. [*][b]Blueprints:[/b] with BlueprintMod installed, paste a blueprint at an exact spot and quarter turn, even on a dedicated server with no player, then check or undo it. [*][b]Console:[/b] run the game's console commands and read the console. [/list] Every tool that rebuilds something has a dry run first. The real run holds the game tick, changes everything in one step, takes from your inventory what the game would charge, gives back what deconstruction would, and checks the result afterwards: connections, pipe contents, rooms and air.
[hr][/hr] [h2]Setup[/h2] [list] [*][b]1. Subscribe[/b] and enable StationGod MCP in StationeersLaunchPad. [*][b]2. Install the sidecar,[/b] the small program the agent starts. In the mod's Workshop folder (steamapps\workshop\content\544550\<item id>\Sidecar) extract [b]StationGodMCP.Server-win-x64.zip[/b] (no .NET needed) or [b]StationGodMCP.Server-portable.zip[/b] (needs .NET 8) to a folder outside every mod folder, for example %LOCALAPPDATA%\StationGodMCP\server. [*][b]3. Register it with your agent.[/b] Claude Code: claude mcp add --scope user stationeers -- "<folder>\StationGodMCP.Server.exe". Codex and other clients: a stdio MCP server running that file. [*][b]4. Host a save.[/b] The mod answers only in a game that hosts: turn on Start Local Host in the game's settings (StartLocalHost in setting.xml), then load a save. A client joined to someone else's server gets no answer. [/list]
[hr][/hr] [h2]Settings[/h2] A single local game needs none. StationeersLaunchPad config editor, or BepInEx/config/net.xceled.stationeers.stationgodmcp.cfg: Name in section Pipe, the rest in section Remote MCP (reaching a dedicated server over the network). Read when the game starts. [table] [tr][th]Setting[/th][th]Default[/th][th]What it does[/th][/tr] [tr][td][b]Name[/b][/td][td]StationGodMCP[/td][td]Name of the local pipe. Give a second game or test server on the same machine its own.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][b]Enabled[/b][/td][td]Off[/td][td]Accept sidecars over TCP. Stays off without a secret.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][b]BindAddress[/b][/td][td]0.0.0.0[/td][td]Address the server listens on.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][b]Port[/b][/td][td]8765[/td][td]TCP port.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][b]Secret[/b][/td][td]empty[/td][td]Shared secret every sidecar must send. Sent unencrypted: use a long random value.[/td][/tr] [/table] Each also reads an environment variable (STATIONGODMCP_PIPE_NAME, STATIONGODMCP_REMOTE_ENABLED, _BIND_ADDRESS, _PORT, _SECRET), handy for Docker.
[hr][/hr] [h2]Removing it[/h2] Everything the agent built or changed is ordinary game content and stays. The one thing the mod adds is the StationGod Gateway (a Logic Memory lookalike printed at the Electronics Printer): gateways and their kits disappear from a save loaded without the mod. Nothing else needs doing.
[hr][/hr] [h2]Good to know[/h2] [list] [*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] the mod does its work on the host, where the game's own state lives, and changes reach players the usual way. The host needs it; players who join do not (a world with a Gateway in it excepted, as the Gateway is a new structure). With it, a player's game shares where they look, so on a dedicated server the camera tools and highlights work for them too. [*][b]Trust:[/b] the agent gets real read and write access to the world, including console commands and device memory. Use an agent you trust, and save first. [*][b]Gateways are optional:[/b] the agent reaches every device in the world without one. A gateway only narrows a call to the devices on its data networks. [*][b]After a game update[/b] the mod checks every game member it relies on at load; a missing one turns off only the tools that need it, and the agent is told why. [*][b]No agent connects?[/b] Look in the BepInEx log for lines starting [b][StationGodMCP][/b]. [/list]
[hr][/hr] [b]Requires[/b] [url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad]StationeersLaunchPad[/url] and an AI agent that speaks MCP.
[b]Source, issues and the full readme:[/b] [url=https://github.com/altmank/Stationeers-StationGodMCP]github.com/altmank/Stationeers-StationGodMCP[/url]
Developed with the use of generative AI, and tokens aren't free. Buy me a coffee: [url=https://ko-fi.com/xceled]ko-fi.com/xceled[/url]
ModMetadata.ChangeLog:
v1.27.2 - remove_structure allow_unsupported: take frames from under a mounted device, which stays and keeps working.
v1.27.1 - Building tools find printer mods and other build parts that do not stack in from_id containers.
v1.27.0 - find_things, find_items, list_containers, outer_frames: order reference_id gives pages that hold while you move.
v1.26.0 - New set_battery_charge: set the charge of single batteries (a cheat).
v1.25.0 - Broken pieces touching a network are reported; refused rocket and broken pipe swaps name the place_pipes call.
v1.24.0 - Shorter default replies: rocket explanations, full logic type lists and looking_at extras on request.
v1.23.1 - Fixed checks on removed game objects.
v1.23.0 - screen_read, screen_press; mine switches miners on.
v1.22.0 - advance_build_state; build states shown; connections summarize.
v1.21.2 - find_things colours; run device counts.
v1.21.1 - rocket_status lists every pipe network.
v1.21.0 - remove_structure gas_to keeps a device's gas; shorter split warnings.
v1.20.0 - Rocket verdicts; container filters.
v1.19.1 - describe_prefab: engine thrust, feed, limits.
v1.19.0 - from_id takes a list of lockers, tried in order per material.
v1.18.1 - output_file and unbuildable-prefab refusals say what to do.
v1.18.0 - upgrade_pipes to repair replaces burst pipes in place; thing_health names why a pipe burst. - Brief swap jobs; open ends in a box.
v1.17.0 - fields works on every reply: a single-object reply (looking_at) keeps the keys named, and a wrong name is answered with the valid ones. - Smaller replies: empty IC pins left out; grid_survey gives a long piece's cell count and box, and occupied_only skips empty cells. - find_things filters by box and says when a rocket part is flying.
v1.16.0 - New clean_chutes: removes chute pieces no item can pass through and simplifies junctions that lose a branch, never dropping items.
v1.15.0 - Short tool descriptions: an agent's tool list is under half its size. The long help moved into the new tool_info tool, read one small topic at a time and answered without the game. - Every error says what went wrong and what to do, and names the tool_info topic that explains it (see). - MCP replies use plain JSON escaping (smaller).
v1.14.1 - Fix: removing neighbouring chute pieces no longer leaves a chute linked to a removed piece. - move_item rechecks the slot before each move and never replaces what it holds; builders take exactly what each build state needs.
v1.14.0 - Small default replies (under 8 KB on a big base); truncated says what was held back. fields reaches nested keys; new omit. get_ic_status leaves the source out unless asked. - set_ic_source source_file deploys a big Lua source from a file; connections area filter; atmosphere_contents reads a Pipe Analyzer's pipe network; console output is captured on a dedicated server. - describe_device shows which downlink a Logic Rocket Uplink follows; new set_uplink.
v1.13.0 - Rocket tools fly every rocket the game builds: all six engines, gas and liquid lines, payloads, transfers, crewed rockets and the Orbital Launch Mount. - New rocket_mining_options: what the miners, heads, collectors and scanners bring home per site, and why not. - rocket_status: compact mode, every part's position from the engine mount (parts), and the landing check the game makes at the pad the rocket is heading for.
v1.12.1 - Fix: a player who rejoined a dedicated server lost the camera tools (no_view).
v1.12.0 - Dedicated servers: a player whose game runs StationGod shares where they look, so the view tools work for them; without it those calls refuse no_view. - New setting [Multiplayer] ShareViews (default true).
v1.11.0 - Dedicated servers: "the player" means the one connected player when there is no local one; with none or several it refuses, saying which. - Update the mod and the sidecar together: the connection protocol changed (hello first); tool descriptions and argument checks come from one method catalogue.
v1.10.0 - New read_devices: logic, slot logic, atmospheres and reagents of up to 128 things in one call; thing_health reads a whole network (network_id).
v1.9.1 - mod_info runtime: what the mod costs the game: per-method time, main-thread wait and reply size; requests and time per frame; heap. - New setting [Performance] RequestBudgetMs (default 4 ms): requests past it in one frame wait for the next, in order. - Leaving a world clears what the mod held about it: chips paused by control_ic_execution run again; jobs, undo records, print and flight logs are forgotten. - Fix: a job's gas work that overran its 10 s limit no longer runs on after the job let the game tick go; the tick waits for it and pipe jobs are held until its result is accepted. - Less garbage per read; highlights cost nothing while none is shown.
v1.9.0 - Large replies: output_file writes a reply to a JSON file and answers a pointer; fields keeps only the named keys. - find_things location; connections prefab_contains and open_ends_only; rocket tools burn fuel at Terraforming Reloaded's combustion rate. - Confirmed place/remove runs answer briefly (verbose: true for all); scripts on the pipe are held to each tool's argument names.
v1.8.0 - rocket_status, rocket_forecast (flies a copy of a rocket by the game's rules: fuel, time, battery, landing verdict, what-ifs) and rocket_flight_log.
v1.7.0 - Smaller replies: grid_survey sections, network_ids and compact; get_ic_status include_source; item_totals holders_limit; job polls brief by default. - highlight (through walls), deep_miner_spots, controls_blocked warnings, lint rules as data (lint-rules.json, lint_rules) and dry-run lint in the place and plan tools. - Fix: Compact Filtration is no longer built upside down.
v1.6.2 - Fix: remove_structure gives a frame's cell back to the air as hand deconstruction does.
v1.6.1 - Fix: chutes join rocket chute umbilicals either way.
v1.6.0 - Rockets: place_structure builds every rocket part as a player does; the cable, pipe, chute and remove tools work in rockets; umbilical pairing in describe_device and grid_survey.
v1.5.0 - Safety fixes: gas kept through splits and swaps, no items lost in hidden slots, power overload guard, fair trader_sell. - check_replaceable; only placements a player could make; acknowledge_gas_lost; remove_structure allow_burst; refund_to; would_overload_when_on. - Strict arguments: unknown arguments and ids sent as numbers are refused.
v1.4.4 - Mesh boxes decide clashes (place_structure, find_spot, wall_map, lint_layout); undo_job puts back removed pipes and cables.
v1.4.3 - Placement and layout tools: orient, wall_map, find_spot, lint_layout, undo_job, show_preview, door keep-outs and more.
v1.4.2 - Broken structures: found by find_things and thing_health, removed with remove_structure allow_broken.
v1.4.1 - Fix: pipe jobs that merged networks more than once lost gas; every pipe job now settles and checks its gas.
v1.4.0 - Ingot Vault tools: vault_contents, vault_deposit, vault_withdraw (needs the Ingot Vault mod).
v1.3.5 - Layout helpers: rotation readout, port preview, reserved cells and ports, move_gas dry_run.
v1.3.4 - move_gas takes a room as from or to.
v1.3.3 - move_gas from the planet: delete named gases from the planet's air (needs Terraforming Reloaded).
v1.3.2 - Landing pad atmospheres in the gas tools; move_gas checks the receiving side by the game's matter rules.
v1.3.1 - Live-run fixes: devices placeable again, walls back to back, aimed devices stand on the floor.
v1.3.0 - Network refactor tools: split reports, remove_redundant, tap checks, network handles, queued jobs.
v1.2.0 - assume_removed, prefer hidden, trunk routes, feed_paths, plan_removal; refunds go into the inventory.
v1.1.1 - inside_frames accepts beam tops; reroute between an APC and its network.
v1.1.0 - paste_blueprint (with BlueprintMod); [Pipe] Name setting.
v1.0.0 - First release: 71 tools.
Full notes: CHANGELOG.md on GitHub.
